facts.fact: DLA Piper states that Mozambique has no specific data protection or privacy legislation, only sector laws imposing some privacy obligations and a cybersecurity bill under discussion; the guide gives no event date, so its last-modified date of 17 February 2026 is used.
DLA Piper lists Resolution no. 5/2019 of 20 June as ratifying the African Union Convention on Cybersecurity and Personal Data Protection for Mozambique.
